# ktune-run6 (test branch): memory with tabs, a game and a call at once on 3.3 GB
serial 2026111620
kernel lz4 +ZRAM_BACKEND_LZ4
run memory lz4 MEMRUNS=180:100:zstd,100:100:zstd,60:100:zstd,200:100:zstd,180:150:zstd,180:100:lz4 TABS=300,300,300,200 GAME=1000
run memory lz4 MEMRUNS=180:100:lz4,180:150:zstd,200:100:zstd,60:100:zstd,100:100:zstd,180:100:zstd TABS=300,300,300,200 GAME=1000
